name: unity-kit
description: Guardrails and workflow for Claude Code in Unity 6 projects: .meta and Library guards, broken-reference and compile gates, build and test fix loops, pre-commit checks, and Unity code and performance reviewers.

batch_compile.title: Compile in batch mode at end of turn
batch_compile.description: When the Editor does not have the project open and no Unity-Skills server answers, the Stop hook launches Unity in batch mode to check compilation. Slower on large projects. /unity-kit:compile-fix can always use batch mode.
